about_the_game:
GunJong is a solo Mahjong puzzle game with guns.
Match tiles by symbol, aim, and shoot to clear the board.
It’s fast to learn and hard to master.

Core Gameplay

  • Look for open matches

  • Aim your shot so the path is clear

  • Remove pairs to open new routes

  • Finish the board with smart, clean plays

Why Play GunJong?

  • Shoot tiles to solve puzzles in a new way

  • Plan your path to open matches and save shots

  • Chase medals for speed, accuracy, and shot efficiency

  • Replay boards to improve times and scores

  • Play in short sessions or settle in for longer runs

  • Import your own images as custom patterns to solve

  • Choose VR for full immersion or PC mouse and keyboard for comfort

Modes

Campaign

  • Around 9 handcrafted boards atm

  • Boards arranged into a multi-hour campaign that teaches and tests each mechanic

  • Clear goals on every stage

  • Earn medals based on your performance

Trials

  • Focused challenges for speed and precision

  • Push your best runs and climb leaderboards

Zen

  • No pressure play

  • urn on optional rule toggles and relax

Mechanics

Atm you’ll face 5 core mechanics that change how you play:

  • Blockers that force new angles and routes

  • Limited angles that make aim and position matter

  • Timed locks that open after a short wait

  • Moving obstacles

  • Dissapearing tiles

Progression and Replay

  • Campaign play to show all mechanics 

  • Earn medals on each board

  • Connect different boards and multiple mechanics togheter

  • Improve accuracy and shot count to raise your rank

  • Compete on leaderboards for your best times and scores

  • Return to earlier boards with new skills and crush your Highscores

Accessibility and Options

  • Left or right hand

  • Comfort settings

  • Optional rule toggles to tailor difficulty and pace

Controls and Platform

  • Designed for headset and tracked controllers

  • Fully playable on PC with mouse and WASD

  • Languages: English, Polish

  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • VR Support: OpenXR

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM

  • VR Support: OpenXR

short_description: Single-player action puzzle game for PC and VR where you clear mahjong tiles with guns. Read the layout, line up clean shots, and solve handcrafted boards while chasing medals for speed, accuracy, and fewest shots.
supported_languages: English, Polish, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Hindi
